newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 15.312 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 15.312 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold two discount T-bill issues on Monday with maturities of one and four weeks, yielding 3.82 percent and 17.76 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 15,312.1 million levs ($7.3 million) of T-bills and the ministry approved all the bids.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction dates and maturity dates for both issues overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 7,399.1 million levs 7,913 million levs
Bids approved 7,399.1 million levs 7,913 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.82 pct 17.76 pct
